title: The Logotype: Incorrect Uses
slide_intent: Show which alterations undermine a signature. Specific counterexamples let a reviewer recognize a misuse during production.
strategic_value: NASA can preserve the silhouette and horizontal orientation of its mark by showing exactly which alterations to catch.
demonstration: Nine numbered treatments correspond to nine cautions above. The specimens cover a pattern over the strokes, enclosures, an outline, a shadow, distortion, screened tones and a vertical orientation.
practical_value: Compare proposed artwork with the numbered examples and identify the particular alteration that conflicts with the master.
